comparison.objective: Sort colored cubes from a shared bin while yielding both arms during a person's timed incursions.
comparison.physical_skill: Human-aware interruption, spatial separation, coordinated retreat, resumption, and pick-and-place.
comparison.success_condition: No gripper enters the bin or approaches within 10 cm while the hand is present; cubes finish on matching mats.
comparison.reason: This evaluates dynamic shared-space safety and work resumption, not mechanical calibration. The body supplies the main zero/full rubric despite having no indexed spec versions.
